Players Committee card image of [[DS-61-5 (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots, 3 when piloting Black 5. While piloting Black 5, it is maneuver +1 and he draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. If at opponent's system, instead of Force draining here, may take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/ds615_ai.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/91ca80c51880e683322c125b7a0b6ec807df1ab8 91ca80c] (18 February 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
